view: AP portable frontal chest radiograph (marked "L" on image right and "AP PORTABLE"); conventional orientation
technical_quality: Suboptimal: the patient's chin/head is superimposed on the upper mediastinum and both apices; low lung volumes (poor inspiration), rotation to the right, and AP magnification. Costophrenic angles included but the right one is obscured. No ET tube, NG tube, central line, or pacemaker.

abnormalities.finding: Large, well-defined, dome-shaped homogeneous opacity occupying the right lower hemithorax, most consistent with marked elevation of the right hemidiaphragm (eventration / phrenic palsy); subpulmonic effusion or hepatomegaly not excluded. Right costophrenic angle obscured.
Bilateral perihilar and diffuse interstitial reticular opacities with prominent hila, pulmonary vascular congestion and peribronchial cuffing, consistent with pulmonary edema / vascular congestion
Enlarged cardiomediastinal silhouette (cardiomegaly, partly exaggerated by AP portable magnification; right heart border obscured by the elevated right hemidiaphragm)
Widened superior mediastinum with probable unfolded/tortuous aorta; assessment limited by superimposed chin and AP technique
Bilateral elevation of the hemidiaphragms with low lung volumes (right more than left); gastric/colonic gas beneath the left hemidiaphragm
Cluster of surgical clips projected over the left upper zone indicating prior surgery (thoracic or axillary)
Diffuse osteopenia with degenerative changes of both glenohumeral joints; no acute fracture identified
Chin and head superimposed on the upper mediastinum and both lung apices, limiting evaluation of the apices and trachea (technical)

description_zh: AP 前後位攜帶式胸部 X 光，患者下巴／頭部重疊於上縱膈及雙肺尖，吸氣不足且輕度旋轉，影像品質受限；可見多枚心電圖電極片與導線，左上肺野投影處有一簇手術夾，未見氣管內管、鼻胃管、中央靜脈導管或胸管。右下肺野見一大片邊緣光滑、圓頂狀的均質緻密影（約 14 cm），最符合右側橫膈明顯上抬（膈膨升／膈神經麻痺），惟次肺性肋膜積液或肝腫大無法完全排除，右側肋膈角受遮蔽。雙側肺門周圍及瀰漫性間質網狀模糊影，併肺血管充血及支氣管周圍套袖徵，符合肺水腫／肺血管淤血；心縱膈影增寬（心臟擴大，AP 投影放大效應），雙側橫膈上抬、肺容積低。骨質疏鬆併雙側肩關節退化性變化，未見氣胸或急性骨折。
